name: wapiti-scanner/wapiti
description: Black-box web vulnerability scanner written in Python that crawls web applications and injects payloads to detect SQL injection, XSS, LDAP injection, CSRF, and 30+ other vulnerability types.
score_rationale: Solid open source DAST scanner with 1.7k stars, GPL-2.0 licensed, actively maintained with broad vulnerability module coverage though smaller community than ZAP or Nuclei.
